bookTitle: The Shy Little Dragon and the Lantern Festival
generationMethod: Generated with an image model, one still per page, from the prompts kept alongside this file.

encoding.note: Re-encoded from the delivered 24-bit PNGs to 256-colour PNGs with Floyd-Steinberg dithering. Same pixel dimensions, same file names. This cut the set from 29 MB to 8.7 MB so the art could ship inside the Windows installer; the two were compared side by side and the clay-and-felt texture is preserved.

integrationStatus: Integrated. Shipped as extraResources with the Windows app, served by /api/storybook-scene/<slug>/page_<id>.png, displayed by the Android reader when the book sets hasScenes.

sourceTemplate.note: Hash taken AFTER the per-page alt text from this manifest was folded into the template.

characters.role: your best friend from the village who comes along to help
the shy baby dragon who is afraid of its own glittery hiccups

pages.title: The dragon under the mushroom
pages.altTextTemplate: {{CHILD_NAME}} and {{FRIEND_NAME}} find {{DRAGON_NAME}} beside a large mushroom as a little golden hiccup rises into the sunlight.

pages.title: A gentle hug
pages.altTextTemplate: {{CHILD_NAME}} gives {{DRAGON_NAME}} a gentle hug while {{FRIEND_NAME}} smiles and a tiny silver sparkle floats above them.

pages.title: Your hiccups are magic
pages.altTextTemplate: {{DRAGON_NAME}} peeks past a raised wing at a golden glitter swirl while {{CHILD_NAME}} encourages and {{FRIEND_NAME}} applauds.

pages.title: Practice in the sparkling meadow
pages.altTextTemplate: {{DRAGON_NAME}} giggles in a sparkling meadow while {{CHILD_NAME}} and {{FRIEND_NAME}} cheer.

pages.title: The wise owl's advice
pages.altTextTemplate: A wise owl on an oak branch listens kindly to {{DRAGON_NAME}}, {{CHILD_NAME}} and {{FRIEND_NAME}} below.

pages.title: The edge of the festival
pages.altTextTemplate: {{DRAGON_NAME}} looks nervously toward the festival crowd beside {{CHILD_NAME}} and {{FRIEND_NAME}}, with a little pink hiccup in the air.

pages.title: A secret hand-squeeze
pages.altTextTemplate: {{CHILD_NAME}} and {{DRAGON_NAME}} practice their secret hand-squeeze beneath a willow while {{FRIEND_NAME}} watches supportively.

pages.title: The first lantern needs a spark
pages.altTextTemplate: {{DRAGON_NAME}} peeks from behind {{CHILD_NAME}} as the Lantern Keeper waits beside the first unlit lantern, with {{FRIEND_NAME}} nearby.

pages.title: Everyone is smiling
pages.altTextTemplate: {{CHILD_NAME}} and {{FRIEND_NAME}} cheer as {{DRAGON_NAME}} sends a happy golden glitter shower above the smiling crowd.

pages.title: The Dragon Who Lit the Festival
pages.altTextTemplate: {{DRAGON_NAME}} proudly lights the festival lanterns with a golden ribbon of glitter while {{CHILD_NAME}}, {{FRIEND_NAME}} and the villagers celebrate.
pages.endingTitle: The Dragon Who Lit the Festival

pages.title: A Whole Sky of Sparkles
pages.altTextTemplate: {{CHILD_NAME}} and {{FRIEND_NAME}} dance in rainbow sparkle-snow as {{DRAGON_NAME}} hiccups colorful magic and the Lantern Keeper laughs.

pages.title: The Shyest, Bravest Bow
pages.altTextTemplate: {{DRAGON_NAME}} takes a shy little bow beside {{CHILD_NAME}} and {{FRIEND_NAME}}, and the friendly villagers bow back.
